analysis:
Documentation-only changes. docs/README.md head line 96 adds a link to provider/cache-storage.md, a cache write cap and external APFS volume selection how-to. docs/architecture/cache-aware-routing.md patch (hunk @@ -16,6 +16,11 @@) adds a paragraph: operators may persist a daily cache write cap or choose a UUID-pinned APFS cache volume via `darkbloom cache`; the write ledger stays on the Mac; a missing or unsuitable volume refuses cache construction or active I/O so inference recomputes; the coordinator receipt and routing protocol is unchanged. No code, auth, attestation, encryption or billing paths changed in the supplied units. The page's own header says it was last updated 2026-10-08.

Security points for the next pass: the underlying feature (external cache volume selection) is not in the supplied diff. Reviewers should check the implementing Swift/CLI code if present in other units: whether the cache payload on an external disk stays encrypted (DBK3 HMAC-keyed, T-041), whether the volume UUID pinning rejects a swapped or attacker-prepared disk, whether symlink/no-follow I/O is preserved, and whether the write budget (T-016 disk-fill DoS) cannot be bypassed by switching volumes. The doc claims the ledger remains on the Mac, so a volume change does not reset the allowance. I cannot verify those claims from docs alone. The new cache-storage.md file was not supplied. No threat-model entry is invalidated by these docs.
